versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-douyin-keyword-search-to-video-list.

- Provides CLI tools for searching Douyin videos by keyword, fetching creator works, getting video comments, and checking the real-time hot list.
- Outputs structured JSON data for analysis and workflow automation.
- Built-in token authentication with strict error and output policies.
- Includes robust intent recognition and parameter inference for various content operation scenarios.
- Limits data collection to publicly available content from Douyin only; enforces security and compliance practices.
